action: AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification completed; LinkedIn/resume updated; structured job market scan conducted; community donation made to Financial Triage Navigator; job search trigger conditions committed in writing
narrative: James Patterson sat the AWS Solutions Architect Associate exam this tick and passed — scoring 847, clearing the threshold he had set for himself. Within 24 hours he updated his LinkedIn headline to 'Software Developer | AWS Solutions Architect Associate' and messaged Howard Liu to share the news, keeping the relationship warm after last tick's long-overdue conversation. He ran a 5-hour structured job market scan against his five-company target list and identified one role at a regional healthcare cloud provider that matches his new profile; he did not apply yet but has the application staged. He made the $150 donation to Lisa Freeman's Financial Triage Navigator — quietly, without announcement. He also wrote down, for the first time in twelve ticks, his explicit job search trigger conditions: role security below 0.30, direct layoff signal, or consulting term ending without improvement. Six months of studying on RoboRide commutes converted into a credential, a market posture, and a plan.
